description: The plot illustrates the relationship between computational power, measured in TFLOPs, and loss ratio in percentage. The x-axis represents TFLOPs, has a custom scale, and ranges from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks labeled at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the loss ratio in percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 94% to 100%, marked at regular intervals of 1. The plot contains five lines: the purple line with triangle markers and a solid style, representing 'Vanilla', remains constant at 100% across the x-axis; the orange line with line markers, representing 'SepLLM (n=64)', increases from approximately 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 100% at 3e8 TFLOPs, peaks at 100.2% near 4e8, and remains around 100% until 9e8 TFLOPs; the blue line with cross markers, depicting 'SepLLM (n=128)', starts at about 97% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to 99.8% at 3e8 TFLOPs, and ends at 99% at 9e8 TFLOPs; the green line with diamond markers, representing 'SepLLM (n=64, H)', begins at approximately 97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs, peaks at 100% near 3e8 TFLOPs, and stabilizes at 99% at 9e8 TFLOPs; the red line with round markers, showing 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)', starts at 94% at 1e7 TFLOPs, peaks at around 98% near 3e8 TFLOPs, and declines to 98.5% at 4e8 before ending at around 96.5% near 9e8 TFLOPs.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between computational power, measured in TFLOPs, and loss ratio in percentage. The x-axis represents TFLOPs and has a custom scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks labeled at intervals like 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the loss ratio in percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 94% to 100%, marked at regular intervals of 1. Five lines are depicted in this plot. The purple line with triangle markers and a solid style represents the 'Vanilla' method, which remains constant at 100% across the x-axis. The orange line with line markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64)' and increases from approximately 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs, peaking at 102% near 4e8. The blue line with cross markers depicts 'SepLLM (n=128)', starting at about 97% and ending at 99%, with a steady increase. The green line with diamond markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' and follows a similar pattern, beginning at approximately 97.5% and peaking at 101% before stabilizing at 99%. The red line with round markers shows 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)', starting at 94%, peaking at around 98% near 4e8 TFLOPs, and declining to 96% near the end of the x-axis. A legend is given at the bottom right.
